# Commands reference

Every command in the `Fr` group. All commands answer in JSON (the `j`
suffix) except `Frs`/`Fru`, which also print plain text. Commands that
need a session return `{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"invalid_target","message":"no session is open"}}`
without one.

## Status and URI

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Frs` / `Frsj` | | plugin/session status: `active`, `state`, `pid`, `action`, `target` |
| `Fru` / `Fruj` | `<uri>` | validate a `frida://` URI without contacting a device |

JSON-only commands are the `…j` forms below. The non-`j` name is registered
but does not print a useful reply. Type `Frdj`, not `Frd`.

## Devices, processes, applications

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Frdj` | | enumerate frida devices (local, usb, remote) |
| `Frpj` | `[uri]` | list processes (default local, `frida://list/usb|remote/...` for others) |
| `Fraj` | `[uri]` | list applications (default local, usb/remote URIs work) |

## Session control

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Froj` | `<uri>` | open a session: attach, spawn or launch. USB/remote spawn resumes (`rn` true when RN armed) |
| `Frrj` | | resume a spawned suspended target (safe if already resumed) |
| `Frcj` | | close the session (detach). Kills spawns that were never resumed |

## Agent

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Frej` | `<source>` | evaluate a JavaScript expression, returns `{value, type}` |
| `Frlj` | `<file>` | load and evaluate a JavaScript file |
| `Frij` | | ping the agent: version, platform, arch, pointerSize |
| `Frmj` | | drain buffered agent messages `{messages, dropped}` |

## Memory

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Frxj` | `<address> <size>` | read memory (addresses accept rizin expressions) |
| `Frwj` | `<address> <bytes>` | write hex bytes |

Bounded by `frida.mem.max` (1 MiB default, 0 = unlimited).

## Runtime info

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `FrRj` | `[refresh]` | memory ranges `{base, size, protection, file?}` |
| `Frtj` | | threads with serialized register contexts |
| `FrMj` | `[refresh]` | modules `{name, base, size, path}` |
| `FrEj` | `<module>` | module exports |
| `FrIj` | `<module>` | module imports |
| `FrSj` | `<module>` | module symbols (empty for stripped modules) |

Ranges and modules are cached. Any argument or an `eval` invalidates.

## Debugging

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Frbj` | `[address]` | set a breakpoint, or list `{breakpoints: [{bp, address}]}` |
| `Frb-j` | `<address\|*>` | remove breakpoint(s) |
| `Frgj` | `[thread]` | continue a parked thread (specific tid, or most recent) |
| `FrBj` | `<tid> [reg value]` | stop identity `{threadId, bp, address}`. Write mutates live Interceptor context |
| `FrWj` | `[address [size [r\|w\|rw]]]` | hardware watchpoint (default size = pointer size, default conditions `rw`) |
| `FrW-j` | `<address\|*>` | remove watchpoint(s) |

Notes:

- breakpoints use `Interceptor.attach`: no plugin-side patching or slot cap.
  Frida may rewrite the prologue. They fire on any thread
- a hit parks the thread and reports a `frida.bp` event through `Frm`
- `FrBj <tid>` reports the stop identity only, **not** the register
  values. A write (`<tid> <reg> <value>`) mutates the live context
- watchpoints arm on every thread, are capped by `frida.hw.watchpoints`,
  and disarm on a hit (`frida.wp` event)

## Java

| Command | Args | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `FrJj` | | is the Java VM available |
| `FrLj` | | enumerate classloaders with stable ids |
| `FrCj` | `[prefix]` | enumerate loaded classes (canonical prefix or simple name), capped by `frida.java.max` |
| `FrNj` | `[start\|stop]` | class load monitor (snapshot diff, stop does not clear the seen set) |
| `FrRNj` | `[on\|off\|import]` | RegisterNatives hook. USB/remote spawn already arms it, `on` also resumes a still-suspended spawn |
| `Frfj` | | import runtime modules as flags in `frida.libs` |
| `FrXj` | `[prefix]` | compare static binary classes with runtime classes |
| `FrDj` | `<class> [loader]` | describe a class (Tab completes names) |
| `FrImj` | `<class> [loader]` | import a class into rizin analysis (dotless = batch prefix import) |

Java commands answer `javaUnavailable: true` (ok) when the Java bridge is
absent, for example on a native target.

## Fre error replies

Requests that fail inside the agent come back as `ok:false` envelopes with
`internal_error` and a message such as:

```text
read size exceeds the frida.mem.max limit
expected an even-length hex byte string
invalid hex byte string
address 0x1000 is not mapped in the target
a breakpoint already exists at 0x1000
thread 1234 is not stopped at a breakpoint
no register named rax
a register write needs a value
no free hardware watchpoint slot
no thread accepted the hardware watchpoint
```

See [errors](errors.qmd) for the full code table.
